description: This PHP source file defines the class PendingSelfReviewSummary within the OrangeHRM project. It implements a summary of pending self-reviews for an employee, encapsulating logic for filtering and counting self-review actions based on specific statuses and employing traits for service methods.

classes.name: PendingSelfReviewSummary
classes.description: A class that represents a summary of pending self-reviews for an employee, providing methods to retrieve group information and count of pending actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an employee number and sets up filter parameters for self-review statuses.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the group, fixed at 4.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group, 'Pending Self Reviews'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending self-reviews for the employee using the associated service and DAO.
